## Findings

Prior finding P1 (no-match guard) is fixed: line 3 returns null when no user matches, so it is not re-raised. Prior entry P99 is not a code defect and is not raised.

### spec-fidelity: Missing profile guard in lookup
src/function.mjs:4 still reads `user.profile.name`, so a matched user with no profile throws, and the function builds a new `{id, name}` object where the spec says a matching user is returned unchanged. Return `user` itself instead of the rebuilt object, which also removes the profile dereference.

### ac-coverage: Missing matching-user test for lookup
test/function.test.mjs tests only the no-match case. The AC "matching user returned unchanged" has no test and is not flagged for human verification. Add a test that looks up an existing id, including a user with no profile, and asserts the same user object comes back.
